correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly covers every bounded mean-zero separable copula density, including zero kernels. Endpoint essential bounds give genuine nonnegative conditional densities and a binary U-to-J-to-V Markov construction; binary DPI gives the sharp universal cap. Equality in both DPI inequalities enforces the same fair Bernoulli label determined by each margin, yielding exactly all equal-mass bipartition copulas. Conditional-covariance and rearrangement inequalities establish the full Spearman range, the exact integration-by-parts identity establishes Kendall correlation, and an explicitly parametrized half-partition saturates the cap for every real feasible correlation including endpoints and zero. Exact Fraction checker verified 12 values and all density cells; finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general copula maximum-information theorem could dominate the proposed restricted-class result only if it imposed an appropriate rank-one constraint; unrestricted copulas can have mutual information beyond one bit. Classical finite-state DPI gives the ceiling, but does not imply conditional attainability for all rank values or classify precisely the equality kernels.

originality.rationale: The inspected full 2026 model source proves stochastic representation and the rank envelope but not the conditional Shannon mutual-information maximization. Independently checked 2023 primary text solves the opposite minimum-information problem, an open 2023 Lancaster-Sarmanov study treats spatial asymptotic decay, and a closely related published FGM entropy result concerns block substitution. The present flat upper envelope for every rank and iff equality classification are not shown or implied by those inspected scientific statements. DPI and binary entropy are acknowledged as standard, and unresolved 2014/2022 publication priority risks are disclosed instead of being mislabeled noncovering.
residual_risks: The full text of Ebrahimi, Jalali and Soofi (2014), DOI:10.1016/j.jmva.2014.06.014, was inaccessible, despite arXiv, OA and permitted institutional attempts. The abstract concerns dependence information among uncorrelated models and could contain a related narrower identity or bound; this exact comparison remains unresolved.

A 2022 Sarmanov-family information-measures article (DOI:10.1007/s40840-022-01241-z) was not fully accessible; its published summary concerns order-statistic concomitant information rather than the stated universal rank-one capacity.
Contemporaneous or unindexed equivalent results cannot be excluded; database search and source-inspection evidence do not establish absolute novelty.

value.rationale: For a natural one-factor dependence model with known sharp rank range, the complete maximum-mutual-information curve and iff optimizer classification are new structural information. The constant one-bit upper envelope under every prescribed rank, particularly simultaneous vanishing Spearman and Kendall coefficients, shows that these statistics do not attenuate information capacity in the class. The result is a full natural parameter-range optimization, not an arbitrary parameter slice, textbook rephrasing, or merely a finite calculation; its scope exclusions are explicit.
